project.title: activated sludge metagenome Raw sequence reads
project.description: This project presents metagenomic sequencing data of seven HAP-anammox granular sludge samples collected from an expanded granular sludge bed reactor. The reactor experienced severe mineralization due to elevated influent calcium and phosphorus concentrations, resulting in poor total nitrogen removal performance. The granules were classified by visual color into red (low-mineralization, potentially high-activity) and white (high-mineralization, potentially low-activity) fractions, and further separated by particle size. The dataset includes A1 (mixed-color, 0.355-0.9 mm), A2-A4 (red, 0.9-2.0 mm, 2.0-2.8 mm, and >2.8 mm), and W2-W4 (mineralized, 0.9-2.0 mm, 2.0-2.8 mm, and >2.8 mm). These data will be used to investigate how mineralization affects microbial community structure, anammox activity, and biomineralization processes in HAP-anammox systems.
